verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Card Expenses API and Bills API allow manual/API-based ingestion and marking as 'synced' into an ERP, plus webhooks for event notifications, but there is no documented native, bidirectional, real-time ERP sync (e.g., QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite connector) that eliminates manual journal entries. missing for 10: named ERP integrations/connectors, evidence of automatic two-way sync of journal entries, and confirmation that reconciliation doesn't require manual matching.
